title: Current QUIC baseline
summary: The current source baseline is ooRexx QUIC Socket Provider v0.1-dev3. It is a real OpenSSL QUIC provider with TLS 1.3, provider-neutral negotiation/readiness, accepted peer SocketAddress identity and real multiplexed child streams.
invariants: The source release is oorexx_quic_socket_provider_v0.1-dev3.zip with SHA-256 34a224252f33079cdbe78d4e5f6f122c0cdd6524364f92e95da36bc233b54749.
The package records SocketProvider v0.1-dev14 as its build-time common contract; later estate qualification against dev16 is evidence of compatibility, not a retroactive source rewrite.
QUIC remains a sibling provider and is not folded into the common SocketProvider implementation.
